metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 IPAM activity
properties.query:
let parser = (
  starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
  endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  operation_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  eventresult:string='*',
  object_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  newvalue_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
  disabled:bool=false,
  pack:bool=false
) {
let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
[
  "AdvertiseByoipCidr", "Execute", "BYOIP CIDR",
  "AllocateIpamPoolCidr", "Create", "IPAM Pool",
  "AssociateIpamByoasn", "Set", "BYOIP CIDR",
  "AssociateIpamResourceDiscovery", "Set", "VPC IPAM",
  "CreateIpam", "Create", "IPAM",
  "CreateIpamExternalResourceVerificationToken", "Create", "IPAM Verification Token",
  "CreateIpamPolicy", "Create", "IPAM Policy",
  "CreateIpamPool", "Create", "IPAM Pool",
  "CreateIpamPrefixListResolver", "Create", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "CreateIpamPrefixListResolverTarget", "Create", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver Target",
  "CreateIpamResourceDiscovery", "Create", "IPAM Resource Discovery",
  "CreateIpamScope", "Create", "IPAM Scope",
  "CreatePublicIpv4Pool", "Create", "Public Ipv4 Pool",
  "DeleteIpam", "Delete", "IPAM",
  "DeleteIpamExternalResourceVerificationToken", "Delete", "IPAM Verification Token",
  "DeleteIpamPolicy", "Delete", "IPAM Policy",
  "DeleteIpamPool", "Delete", "IPAM Pool",
  "DeleteIpamPrefixListResolver", "Delete", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "DeleteIpamPrefixListResolverTarget", "Delete", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver Target",
  "DeleteIpamResourceDiscovery", "Delete", "IPAM Resource Discovery",
  "DeleteIpamScope", "Delete", "IPAM Scope",
  "DeletePublicIpv4Pool", "Delete", "Public Ipv4 Pool",
  "DeprovisionByoipCidr", "Execute", "BYOIP CIDR",
  "DeprovisionIpamByoasn", "Execute", "IPAM",
  "DeprovisionIpamPoolCidr", "Execute", "IPAM Pool",
  "DeprovisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr", "Execute", "Public Ipv4 Pool",
  "DescribeByoipCidrs", "Read", "BYOIP CIDR",
  "DescribeIpamByoasn", "Read", "ASN",
  "DescribeIpamExternalResourceVerificationTokens", "Read", "IPAM Verification Token",
  "DescribeIpamPolicies", "Read", "IPAM Policy",
  "DescribeIpamPoolAllocations", "Read", "IPAM Pool Allocation",
  "DescribeIpamPools", "Read", "IPAM Pool",
  "DescribeIpamPrefixListResolverTargets", "Read", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver Target",
  "DescribeIpamPrefixListResolvers", "Read", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "DescribeIpamResourceDiscoveries", "Read", "IPAM Resource Discovery",
  "DescribeIpamResourceDiscoveryAssociations", "Read", "IPAM Resource Discovery Association",
  "DescribeIpamScopes", "Read", "IPAM Scope",
  "DescribeIpams", "Read", "IPAM",
  "DescribeIpv6Pools", "Read", "IPV6 Pool CIDR",
  "DescribePublicIpv4Pools", "Read", "Public Ipv4 Pool",
  "DisableIpamOrganizationAdminAccount", "Disable", "IPAM Account",
  "DisableIpamPolicy", "Disable", "IPAM Policy",
  "DisassociateIpamByoasn", "Set", "ASN",
  "DisassociateIpamResourceDiscovery", "Delete", "IPAM Resource Discovery Assocation",
  "EnableIpamOrganizationAdminAccount", "Enable", "VPC",
  "EnableIpamPolicy", "Enable", "IPAM Policy",
  "GetAssociatedIpv6PoolCidrs", "Read", "IPV6 Pool CIDR",
  "GetEnabledIpamPolicy", "Read", "IPAM Policy",
  "GetIpamAddressHistory", "Read", "IPAM Scope",
  "GetIpamDiscoveredAccounts", "Read", "IPAM Discovery",
  "GetIpamDiscoveredPublicAddresses", "Read", "IPAM Discovery",
  "GetIpamDiscoveredResourceCidrs", "Read", "IPAM Discovery",
  "GetIpamPolicyAllocationRules", "Read", "IPAM Policy",
  "GetIpamPolicyOrganizationTargets", "Read", "IPAM Policy",
  "GetIpamPoolAllocations", "Read", "IPAM Pool",
  "GetIpamPoolCidrs", "Read", "IPAM Pool",
  "GetIpamPrefixListResolverRules", "Read", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "GetIpamPrefixListResolverVersionEntries", "Read", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "GetIpamPrefixListResolverVersions", "Read", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "GetIpamResourceCidrs", "Read", "IPAM Pool",
  "ModifyIpam", "Set", "IPAM",
  "ModifyIpamPolicyAllocationRules", "Set", "IPAM Policy",
  "ModifyIpamPool", "Set", "IPAM Pool",
  "ModifyIpamPoolAllocation", "Set", "IPAM Pool Allocation",
  "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolver", "Set", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver",
  "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolverTarget", "Set", "IPAM Prefix List Resolver Target",
  "ModifyIpamResourceCidr", "Set", "IPAM Resource",
  "ModifyIpamResourceDiscovery", "Set", "IPAM Resource Discovery",
  "ModifyIpamScope", "Set", "IPAM Scope",
  "MoveByoipCidrToIpam", "Execute", "BYOIP CIDR",
  "ProvisionByoipCidr", "Execute", "Elastic IP address",
  "ProvisionIpamByoasn", "Execute", "ASN",
  "ProvisionIpamPoolCidr", "Execute", "IPAM Pool",
  "ProvisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr", "Execute", "Public Ipv4 Pool",
  "ReleaseIpamPoolAllocation", "Delete", "IPAM Pool Allocation",
  "WithdrawByoipCidr", "Delete", "BYOIP CIDR"
]
| where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in (eventtype_in)
| where array_length(object_has_any) == 0 or Object has_any (object_has_any);
AWSCloudTrail
| where not(disabled)
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
| where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
| where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0 or EventName has_any (operation_has_any)
| where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or UserIdentityUserName has_any (actorusername_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    or (ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0")
        and has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIpAddress, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
| where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
| extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
| where eventresult == "*" or EventResult == eventresult
| lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
| extend Req = todynamic(RequestParameters), Resp = todynamic(ResponseElements)
| extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
    EventName == "AllocateIpamPoolCidr", Req.AllowedCidr,
    EventName == "AssociateIpamByoasn", Resp.asnAssociation,
    EventName == "AssociateIpamResourceDiscovery", Resp.ipamResourceDiscoveryAssociation,
    EventName in ("CreateIpam", "ModifyIpam"), Resp.ipam,
    EventName == "CreateIpamExternalResourceVerificationToken",
      Resp.ipamExternalResourceVerificationToken,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPolicy", Resp.ipamPolicy,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPool", Resp.ipamPool,
    EventName in ("CreateIpamPrefixListResolver", "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolver"),
      Resp.ipamPrefixListResolver,
    EventName in ("CreateIpamPrefixListResolverTarget", "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolverTarget"),
      Resp.ipamPrefixListResolverTarget,
    EventName in ("CreateIpamResourceDiscovery", "ModifyIpamResourceDiscovery"),
      Resp.ipamResourceDiscovery,
    EventName in ("CreateIpamScope", "ModifyIpamScope"), Resp.ipamScope,
    EventName in ("DeprovisionByoipCidr", "MoveByoipCidrToIpam", "ProvisionByoipCidr", "WithdrawByoipCidr"),
      Resp.byoipCidr,
    EventName in ("DeprovisionIpamByoasn", "ProvisionIpamByoasn"), Resp.byoasn,
    EventName in ("DeprovisionIpamPoolCidr", "ProvisionIpamPoolCidr"), Resp.ipamPoolCidr,
    EventName == "DeprovisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr", Resp.deprovisionedAddressSet,
    EventName == "EnableIpamOrganizationAdminAccount", Resp.success,
    EventName == "ModifyIpamPolicyAllocationRules", Resp.ipamPolicyDocument,
    EventName == "ModifyIpamPool", Resp.ipamPoolId,
    EventName == "ModifyIpamPoolAllocation", Resp.ipamPoolAllocation,
    EventName == "ModifyIpamResourceCidr", Resp.ipamResourceCidr,
    EventName == "ProvisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr", Resp.poolAddressRange,
    ""
  ), "")
| where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0 or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
| extend ObjectId = case(
    EventName == "AdvertiseByoipCidr", Resp.byoipCidr.cidr,
    EventName == "AllocateIpamPoolCidr", Resp.ipamPoolAllocation.ipamPoolAllocationId,
    EventName in ("AssociateIpamByoasn", "DisassociateIpamByoasn", "ProvisionIpamByoasn"),
      Req.Asn,
    EventName == "AssociateIpamResourceDiscovery",
      Resp.ipamResourceDiscoveryAssociation.ipamResourceDiscoveryAssociationId,
    EventName == "CreateIpam", Resp.ipam.ipamId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamExternalResourceVerificationToken",
      Resp.ipamExternalResourceVerificationToken.ipamExternalResourceVerificationTokenId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPolicy", Resp.ipamPolicy.ipamPolicyId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPool", Resp.ipamPool.ipamPoolId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPrefixListResolver",
      Resp.ipamPrefixListResolver.ipamPrefixListResolverId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamPrefixListResolverTarget",
      Resp.ipamPrefixListResolverTarget.ipamPrefixListResolverTargetId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamResourceDiscovery",
      Resp.ipamResourceDiscovery.ipamResourceDiscoveryId,
    EventName == "CreateIpamScope", Resp.ipamScope.ipamScopeId,
    EventName in ("CreatePublicIpv4Pool", "ProvisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr"), Resp.poolId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpam", "DeprovisionIpamByoasn", "DescribeIpams", "ModifyIpam"),
      Req.IpamId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamExternalResourceVerificationToken",
      "DescribeIpamExternalResourceVerificationTokens"),
      Req.IpamExternalResourceVerificationTokenId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamPolicy", "DescribeIpamPolicies", "DisableIpamPolicy", "EnableIpamPolicy",
      "GetIpamPolicyAllocationRules", "GetIpamPolicyOrganizationTargets", "ModifyIpamPolicyAllocationRules"),
      Req.IpamPolicyId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamPool", "DeprovisionIpamPoolCidr", "DescribeIpamPools", "GetIpamPoolAllocations",
      "GetIpamPoolCidrs", "GetIpamResourceCidrs", "ModifyIpamPool", "ProvisionIpamPoolCidr"),
      Req.IpamPoolId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamPrefixListResolver", "DescribeIpamPrefixListResolvers",
      "GetIpamPrefixListResolverRules", "GetIpamPrefixListResolverVersionEntries",
      "GetIpamPrefixListResolverVersions", "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolver"),
      Req.IpamPrefixListResolverId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamPrefixListResolverTarget", "DescribeIpamPrefixListResolverTargets",
      "ModifyIpamPrefixListResolverTarget"), Req.IpamPrefixListResolverTargetId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamResourceDiscovery", "DescribeIpamResourceDiscoveries",
      "GetIpamDiscoveredAccounts", "GetIpamDiscoveredPublicAddresses", "GetIpamDiscoveredResourceCidrs",
      "ModifyIpamResourceDiscovery"), Req.IpamResourceDiscoveryId,
    EventName in ("DeleteIpamScope", "DescribeIpamScopes", "GetIpamAddressHistory", "ModifyIpamScope"),
      Req.IpamScopeId,
    EventName in ("DeletePublicIpv4Pool", "DeprovisionPublicIpv4PoolCidr", "DescribeIpv6Pools",
      "DescribePublicIpv4Pools", "GetAssociatedIpv6PoolCidrs"), Req.PoolId,
    EventName in ("DeprovisionByoipCidr", "MoveByoipCidrToIpam", "ProvisionByoipCidr", "WithdrawByoipCidr"),
      Req.Cidr,
    EventName == "DescribeByoipCidrs", Resp.byoipCidrSet,
    EventName in ("DescribeIpamResourceDiscoveryAssociations", "DisassociateIpamResourceDiscovery"),
      Req.IpamResourceDiscoveryAssociationId,
    EventName in ("DisableIpamOrganizationAdminAccount", "EnableIpamOrganizationAdminAccount"),
      Req.DelegatedAdminAccountId,
    EventName == "GetEnabledIpamPolicy", Resp.ipamPolicyId,
    EventName == "ModifyIpamPoolAllocation", coalesce(Req.ipamPoolAllocationId,
      Req.IpamPoolAllocationId),
    EventName == "ModifyIpamResourceCidr", Req.ResourceId,
    EventName == "ReleaseIpamPoolAllocation", Req.IpamPoolAllocationId,
    ""
  )
| extend
    Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
    EventCount = int(1),
    EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
    EventSeverity = "Informational",
    EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventVendor = "AWS",
    EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
    Dvc = "CloudTrail",
    EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
    ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
    TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
    TargetAppType = "Service"
| project-rename
    EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
    EventOriginalType = EventName,
    EventUid = AwsEventId,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
    EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
    ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
    ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
    ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
    HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
| extend
    ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
    ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
    SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
    ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
    ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
    ActorUserEntityKey = "",
    AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
    DvcEntityKey = "",
    SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
    TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
    TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
    "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
    "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
    "APIVersion", APIVersion,
    "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
    "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
    "RequestParameters", Req,
    "ResponseElements", Resp
  ), dynamic({}))
| extend
    Operation = EventOriginalType,
    User = ActorUsername,
    IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
    Application = TargetAppName,
    Value = NewValue
| project
    TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
    EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
    EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
    EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
    ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
    SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
    Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
    ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
    AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
    TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(
  starttime,
  endtime,
  srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
  actorusername_has_any,
  operation_has_any,
  eventtype_in,
  eventresult,
  object_has_any,
  newvalue_has_any,
  disabled,
  pack
)
